name: status-badge
title: StatusBadge
description: Outcome with an icon and a word, always: Conformant, Failed, Partial, Running, Never tested.

a11y.pattern: Static <span> with decorative icon and visible word
aria: Icon is aria-hidden; the word carries the meaning
The label may hold markup (React ReactNode, Angular projected content); its text is the visible word, read as one phrase
Sizes (sm, md, lg) change only type and icon scale, never the role or the name
Shapes differ: check, cross, triangle, arc, circle (circled shape: ringed check, ringed cross, dashed ring)
Spin of the running icon stops under reduced motion
Not a live region: announce changes elsewhere if needed
a11y.notes: Do not use the live indicator for a finished result.
